name: Ipamorelin

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A pentapeptide growth hormone secretagogue acting at the ghrelin receptor, selective relative to earlier secretagogues in that it releases GH with little effect on cortisol or prolactin. It has no FDA-approved product and no approved labelling. No FDA label exists. Not equivalent to an approved growth-hormone product.

systems.note: Ghrelin receptor agonism at the somatotroph driving GH release; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.
Raised GH exposure antagonises insulin action.

monitors.why: The practical index of achieved GH exposure.
